chapters.title: 相似，是指方向还是长度？
chapters.en: Alignment and magnitude are different properties.

chapters.title: 先除以各自长度，只保留方向
chapters.en: Normalize both vectors to isolate direction.

chapters.title: 把长度放回来，才得到内积
chapters.en: The dot product restores both magnitudes.

chapters.title: 零向量没有方向
chapters.en: Cosine is undefined for a zero vector.
